rows.en: Mechanic A: "Have you finished recovering Rayblade?!"
Mechanic C: "Y-Yes!"
Mechanic E: "Bosendorfer coming in!"
Mechanic B: "Hey, don't stand there gawking! Do you want to get crushed?!"
Mechanic C: "S-Sorry!"
Ciel: "Father!"
Garyud: "Ah, Ciel. It seems I got a little
carried away. I ended up damaging Bosendorfer."
Ciel: "Father..."
Garyud: "Come now, what knight cries in front of others?
I'm all right. Don't worry."
Ciel: "...Yes."
Celica: "Honestly, he's reckless.
Going into battle in a mech that hasn't been properly adjusted..."
Fain: "What?! Then Bosendorfer..."
Celica: "Wasn't performing at its full potential."
Fain: "Oh..."
Arthur: "Impressive. In that condition, and in an Armored Mech,
you fought evenly against that ≪Ze=Ode≫..."
Garyud: "But our attacks couldn't
penetrate that field...
It seems an Armored Mech is no match for it after all."
Touya: "...So that's a ≪Ze=Ode≫..."
Ymir: "Are you all right? You look pale."
Touya: "Y-Yeah. I'm a little tired... But I'm fine.
Still, how did the sealed Rayblade
start moving?"
Ymir: "I don't know... But perhaps the Resonance Crystal's tone,
which only you could hear, Touya, has something to do with it...
In any case, Rayblade moving saved us."
Ivel: "..."
Celica: "Still, I never imagined a ≪Ze=Ode≫'s field
would be that powerful...
The thought of five more of them out there gives me chills."
Touya: "Five? If that many came at us at once,
we wouldn't stand a chance..."
Ai: "Hey, who's this Lenis the pilot was shouting about?
He seemed to mean you, Touya..."
Emy: "You don't even know that?
Lenis Enroad. 109 years ago, he researched the ≪Ze=Ode≫
as one of the Alchemists.
Before the ≪Terror of Ze=Ode≫, he worked with another
Alchemist, Wenimas Latia,
to try to thwart Dr. Debish's plan.
...Or so the records say."
Touya: "I've heard that."
Ai: "Huh? How do you know?"
Ymir: "Weren't you told on the way here?"
Ai: "...Now that you mention it, I think I heard something like that..."
Ymir: "The mechs called ≪Ze=Ode≫
apparently number six in all. But including that Rayode,
Eleana, Gaiozon, Parthenos and Goderius,
only those five have been confirmed to exist.
We don't know the details.
As for anything else, Bafred Debish,
Wenimas Latia and Lenis Enroad are the only
three researchers whose names we know.
Apparently, they were pilots as well..."
Touya: "...Then the guy in that mech
was someone from over 100 years ago?"
Ymir: "Or someone who believes he is..."
Ai: "He sounded a little too emotional for that.
He didn't seem like some ≪Ze=Ode≫ fanatic either."
Ivel: "...That person is undoubtedly one of those from 109 years ago,
one of the researchers."
Ymir: "Lady Ivel... Are you saying someone who died
has come back to life?"
Ivel: "Resurrection isn't quite the right word.
They have 'come' to this era."
Touya: "A time slip...? So that's why he called himself
a ghost from 100 years ago..."
Ivel: "I don't know why they came to our era.
But the gears of fate have begun to turn.
Ever since that day, 29 years ago..."
Ymir: "29 years ago?"
Ivel: "Oh, no, it's nothing.
More pressing is the fact that Spirit Mech attacks
barely affected that mech."
Emy: "We're analyzing the data as quickly as we can.
If we find a way to interfere with that field,
the Spirit Mechs' output should be enough to fight it."
Ivel: "Yes. I'll leave that to you."
Emy: "Yes!"
Ivel: "...Now, things are about to become busy.
With Rayblade moving..."
Lodis: "Yes. For a start, the Agarthian Council
certainly won't stay quiet..."
Touya: "...Well? Think Rayblade will move?"
Celica: "Hmm... The systems seem to be alive,
but it won't respond at all."
Touya: "Is it broken?"
Celica: "I don't think so...
Well, I'll try a few things."
Yamato: "You seem to be enjoying yourself."
Celica: "Huh? Do I? Hee hee hee...
Well, when I tried to investigate it before,
it had already been sealed away.
Any healthy girl would be excited, right?"
Touya: "...Isn't that just you?"
Celica: "Anyway, the maintenance crew who came with us from York
are here too. We'll get it properly repaired."
Yamato: "Then Ymir and the others are investigating the field?"
Celica: "Yes. Luckily, we managed to extract Rayblade's combat records,
so we're comparing them with Clovis and the others' data
and analyzing it."
Touya: "Is there anything I can do to help?"
Celica: "Hmm... I appreciate the thought.
Leave this to the experts! But once we have some idea what we're doing,
we might need your help too, Touya."
Touya: "Got it. I'll leave it to you until then.
Whenever you need a hand, just say so."
Celica: "Of course. When the time comes,
I won't hesitate to work you hard."
Touya: "Yeah. See you."
Yamato: "Oh... Isn't that Xiujian over there?"
Touya: "Yeah, looks like it... What's he doing?"
Yamato: "He seems to be working on that Spirit Mech..."
Mechanic F: "You'd better not talk to him."
Touya: "Huh? Why not?"
Mechanic F: "That mech's called Ahti.
Apparently, his lover used to pilot it.
She went missing, and ever since then, he
won't let anyone touch it. That's what I heard.
I tried to check it the other day without knowing,
and he nearly 'took me out.'"
Talk to him
Leave him alone
Xiujian: "...What is it?"
Touya: "Huh? Oh, I didn't really need anything..."
Xiujian: "...Then I'd rather you didn't get in my way."
Touya: "...Hey, is it true your lover
used to pilot that mech?"
Xiujian: "...That mechanic...
Always meddling..."
Touya: "Why won't you let anyone touch it?
Don't you trust them?"
Xiujian: "Heh..."
Touya: "What? What's so funny?"
Xiujian: "You have impressive natural talent,
but you still have a long way to go as a Spirit Mech pilot."
Touya: "What do you mean?"
Xiujian: "I'm not saying you should do all the maintenance yourself,
but you should at least adjust the mech you pilot.
Ultimately, the only person who can protect you is yourself."
Touya: "...It's true I've left it all to others, but..."
Xiujian: "Besides, I want this Ahti ready
to move at any time. In case she... Melissa... returns.
So it'll be ready for her."
Touya: "Melissa... So that's your lover's name...
But how did she go missing...?"
Xiujian: "..."
Touya: "Is something wrong?"
Xiujian: "It seems I've said a little too much."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "Touya... Don't ask any more..."
Touya: "...Yeah... Sorry about that. See you."
Aurelie: "Oh, you..."
Touya: "Hmm? Oh, you're..."
Aurelie: "Aurelie Pandavoine.
I watched your fight.
You've got potential, but you've still got a long way to go."
Touya: "Oh? You don't mince words."
Aurelie: "Are you angry?"
Touya: "Well, it doesn't feel great."
Aurelie: "Because I'm a woman?"
Touya: "Huh? That has nothing to do with it."
Aurelie: "..."
Touya: "I don't know what you're getting at,
but maybe dwelling on men and women like that
is just making you oversensitive about it."
Aurelie: "...You've got a mouth on you..."
Yamato: "Hey, Touya..."
Aurelie: "!!"
Yamato: "...Oh."
Touya: "Oh, great. Didn't I tell you not to talk too much
in front of people? It makes things complicated..."
Aurelie: "..."
Yamato: "H-Hey... I'm being stared at..."
Touya: "Was it that much of a shock?
Aurelie: "...S-So cute..."
Yamato: "...Huh? Wha...?"
Aurelie: "So cuuute!♥"
Aurelie: "H-Hey, hey, what's this little one's name?"
Touya: "Huh? Oh, Yamato..."
Aurelie: "Yamato, huh...? What a nice name!
Hello, Yamato!♥"
Touya: "She's a completely different person now..."
Yamato: "N-Nice to meet you, Aurelie..."
Aurelie: "Eee, so cute!
Hey, won't you give Yamato to me?"
Touya: "What?"
Aurelie: "I said, give Yamato to me!
That's what I'm asking!"
Touya: "Don't be stupid! Yamato's my family.
Who in the world would give their family away to someone else?!"
Aurelie: "...Family?"
Yamato: "After Touya lost his parents, he found me
and raised me. We've been together ever since."
Aurelie: "..."
Touya: "What's wrong now?"
Aurelie: "...Sniff..."
Touya: "H-Hey..."
Aurelie: "So that's how it was... Sniff... You...
You've had a really hard life..."
Aurelie: "All right! From today on, think of me
as your big sister. You can lean on me!"
Touya: "Huh? Of all the things to say out of nowhere..."
Aurelie: "And that makes Yamato my little sister too!"
Touya: "...So that's what you're after."
Ai: "There you are! Where have you been wandering off to?!
Ymir's calling for you."
Touya: "Why?"
Ai: "She said something about where you're
staying tonight."
Touya: "Why can't we just stay aboard Liebhofen?"
Ai: "Don't ask me! All she did was ask me
to fetch you. Come on, hurry up!"
Touya: "H-Hey! Don't pull my hand!
Slow down a little."
Ai: "Huh? You want to hold hands with little old Ai
and take your time savoring this moment?
You should've just said so..."
Touya: "Come on, let's go!"
Ai: "Hey! What's with that attitude?!
You're, like, sooo B.A.!"
Touya: "Stop using those code-like words
that I'm not even sure anyone uses anymore. And quit talking in that tone.
It makes me want to kill you.
Anyway, what the hell is this 'B.A.'?"
Ai: "You don't even know that?
'B.A.' stands for Bad Attitude."
Touya: "You know some weirdly difficult words.
If only you'd put that enthusiasm
into something else..."
Ai: "Shut up. Keep talking like that and
the National High School Girls' Union will send a hitman after you."
Touya: "There's an organization like that?"
Ai: "Who knows?"
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "All right, all right. Let's go."
Aurelie: "...That girl's the same as ever..."
Xiujian: "...Heh."
Ai: "I brought him!"
Ymir: "Thank you."
Touya: "What did you need me for?"
Ymir: "Well... It's about where you and Yamato will be staying, Touya.
Right now, Liebhofen
is in the workshop for maintenance,
and the Holy Land's accommodations are full."
Ai: "There are more mechanics here than before.
Besides, they're usually all sleeping together on the hangar floor.
We should at least let them get a proper night's sleep for once..."
Ymir: "So I was thinking you could stay at my sister-in-law's
house. Would that be all right?"
Touya: "That's fine with me, but..."
Ymir: "I'm glad..."
Ai: "Hmm? You're acting a little odd, aren't you?"
Ymir: "Huh? A-Am I?"
Ai: "...Oh! Didn't you say you lived with your brother and his wife, Ymir,
all together?
...Then... Doesn't that mean it's your house, Ymir?!"
Ymir: "Huh? W-Well, I suppose it does..."
Ai: "Oh, no! No way!
Haven't you heard, 'Boys and girls mustn't sit together from the age of seven'?!
Don't you know that saying?!"
Yamato: "Ai knows a lot about the strangest things..."
Ymir: "You seem to have misunderstood something...
I'll be analyzing the ≪Ze=Ode≫'s special field,
so I won't be going home tonight. So..."
Ai: "Then why were you acting all fidgety?"
Ymir: "Because I was worried he'd say no..."
Yamato: "Oh, I see... Ai, you're..."
Ai: "Yamato...
Say another word, and I'll boil you..."
Yamato: "Oh... I don't think I'd like that..."
Ymir: "Then I'll show you the way.
Ai, would you like to come too?"
Ai: "...No. I'm going back to my own room.
See you!"
Touya: "...What's with her?"
Ai: "Hmm. Oh, well."
Ymir: "Would you like to come too, Ai?"
Ai: "Hmm... No, thanks. There's no need to rush."
Ymir: "???"
Ai: "Well, anyway, I'll be going."
Touya: "...What's with her?"
?????: "Welcome. You must be Touya?
I'm the wife of Forzen Jin Clasio.
My name is Paldia. It's a pleasure to meet you.
Thank you for always looking after Ymir."
Touya: "Huh? N-No... I haven't really...
Hmm? Forzen...? You mean that Forzen...?"
Paldia: "Has my husband been rude again?
I scolded him when it happened with Ai...
I'm sorry."
Touya: "Oh, no, nothing like that... Then Ymir's
that Forzen's little sister?"
Ymir: "Yes. Hadn't I mentioned it?"
Touya: "I see... Even a brother and sister can be so different..."
Paldia: "Hee hee, you've found yourself a nice man, Ymir."
Ymir: "Huh?"
Paldia: "Come along, let's continue our talk
over dinner. Today's a day to remember,
so I've splurged a little."
Ymir: "Um, I'll be leaving now, then..."
Paldia: "Huh? Aren't you staying to eat?"
Ymir: "I'm sorry.
There's still some work I need to do."
Paldia: "What? How can one of today's guests of honor
miss dinner? Your boyfriend will be lonely, won't he?"
Touya: "Boyfriend...? Who do you mean?"
Paldia: "Oh, you're quite the joker, aren't you?"
Ymir: "H-Hang on, Paldia!
He and I... We aren't in any special kind of relationship..."
Paldia: "Oh, you don't have to be shy.
You two look lovely together."
Touya: "What?! Y-You mean me?!"
Paldia: "Oh... Was I really mistaken?
This is the first time Ymir has brought a man home,
so I just assumed..."
Ymir: "P-Paldia!"
Paldia: "Oh, my. You don't seem entirely against the idea.
Then it's not too late. Touya,
if you don't already have someone, what do you think of her?"
Ymir: "Stop deciding things for me!
You're making Touya uncomfortable, aren't you? ...I'm sorry."
Touya: "Huh? Oh, I don't really mind..."
Paldia: "Hmm... Ymir.
A word of advice from someone with more experience in love:
you should stop talking to him like that.
Formal speech shows respect,
but it also puts distance between you.
Especially with men."
Ymir: "O-Oh..."
Paldia: "...So, from today on, when you speak to Touya,
you're not allowed to use that formal tone. Understood?"
Ymir: "You can't just decide that..."
Touya: "I'd prefer it that way."
Ymir: "Huh?"
Paldia: "Good. It's settled."
Ymir: "...You truly wouldn't mind?"
Touya: "I'm not using formal speech either, am I?
If you don't mind, Ymir, I'd prefer it."
Ymir: "V-Very well. Then I shall do so."
Touya: "And I don't want you adding '-san'
to my name either."
Ymir: "Y-Yes. I understand... Oh,
no, okay. Got it."
Paldia: "All right. Now that that's happily settled,
let's eat..."
Ymir: "Oh, I really can't... Besides,
it's time I got back to the laboratory."
Paldia: "Really...?
That's a shame, but I can't force you."
Ymir: "I'm sorry.
I'll leave the rest to you.
Make yourself at home, Touya."
Paldia: "Please look after her.
Oh, I don't mean anything odd by that.
Ymir has a tendency to work
a little too hard... You see."
????: "Huh? Mom, where's Ymir?"
Paldia: "Oh, Melvi.
Well, unfortunately, Ymir
still has work to do, so she can't stay today."
Melvi: "No... I was really looking forward to it..."
Touya: "Um... Who's this?"
Paldia: "Oh, let me introduce her.
This is my daughter, Melvi."
Melvi: "..."
Touya: "Good evening."
Melvi: "G-Good evening..."
Paldia: "Oh, my. You're being awfully shy.
What's gotten into you?"
Melvi: "Oh, Mom, you're mean!"
Paldia: "Hee hee hee...
Now, you must be hungry. Let's eat.
Melvi, would you?"
Melvi: "Okaaay!"
Touya: "...Phew... That was delicious. Thank you for the meal."
Paldia: "You're welcome. You're a growing boy, all right.
Seeing you enjoy it so much makes cooking worthwhile."
Melvi: "..."
Yamato: "Someone's looking at me rather intently..."
Touya: "...Want to hold her?"
Melvi: "I-Is it okay...?"
Touya: "Here."
Melvi: "So cute!"
Paldia: "Ymir told me about it,
but you really can talk properly, can't you?"
Touya: "Yeah. It surprised me at first,
but now I've come to think it's pretty nice."
Melvi: "Yamato, up you go! Higher!"
Yamato: "H-Ha ha ha..."
Melvi: "Now, if only Ymir were here,
it'd be even more fun..."
Touya: "You like Ymir, Melvi?"
Melvi: "Yeah! She's so pretty,
and she's kind! When Melvi grows up,
I want to be just like her!"
Touya: "You'll be fine, Melvi."
Melvi: "But... My hair isn't as pretty
as hers..."
Touya: "Really? Just like your mother's,
it's beautiful blond hair."
Melvi: "But Melvi wishes her hair was silver,
like hers... Dad and Dad's dad all have gold hair.
Only she gets to be special. Melvi wants..."
Paldia: "Melvi. It's time for bed.
Touya's tired too, you know."
Melvi: "Aww, can't I stay a little longer?"
Paldia: "No. Come on, change into your pajamas."
Melvi: "Okaaay. Hey, big brother Touya.
Can I sleep with Yamato?"
Touya: "Huh? W-Well, I don't mind... Yamato, what about you?"
Yamato: "I don't mind."
Melvi: "Yaaay! Good night, then!"
Paldia: "Oh, wait a moment...
I'll help you too."
Melvi: "It's okay. I can do it on my own now."
Paldia: "What are you saying? Are you going to take away
one of your mom's pleasures?
Oh, Touya, wait here a moment, please."
Touya: "Yeah."
Touya: "...Family, huh...?"
